name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major cloud or payments outage found since Apple's service disruption on 17 Nov
state: Downdetector logged 6.4 million US outage reports in the week to 17 Nov, as Microsoft, the FAA, Chase and Apple went down, with Apple blaming a faulty internal update (Fortune, 19 Nov). Searches to 22 Nov found no major cloud, CDN or payments outage over 2h in the past 48h, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No action needed. Keep an alternative payment method to hand in case card systems fail.

sources.title: Fortune — Downdetector logged 6.4 million US outage reports in a week

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
